purpose: Recon evidence for `avito search --remove-reserved`: where Avito reports the reservation state of a listing and whether it can be filtered server-side. No cookies, tokens, opaque search context or full response bodies are stored.

context.region: Москва (session region, not changed by the recon)
context.requests: two SSR document reads of the canonical route, one rendered listing page, one same-origin item API call
context.access: no CAPTCHA and no HTTP 429 during the recon

carrier.coverage: present on 50 of 50 rows; typeof over the whole page yielded only "boolean"
carrier.alsoInApi: the /web/1/js/items catalog carries the same key: a refined call (--price-max 30000 --sort date) succeeded with --remove-reserved, which requires a boolean on every row

notTheSource.badges: reserved cards carry ordinary Авито Гарантия / Рыночная цена / Рассрочка in iva.BadgeBarStep; no iva step contains the word Забронировано
notTheSource.rendering: the catalog bundle passes isReserved into the snippet badge component, which prints Забронировано itself
notTheSource.conclusion: reservation must never be inferred from badges, card text or UI styling

semanticsCrossCheck.visiblePage: the rendered listing page shows the control "Товар зарезервирован"
semanticsCrossCheck.reservationInfo: null on every item inspected; not taken into any contract

serverSideFilter.searched: full filtersV2 JSON of the canonical route (30746 chars) plus the stored full schemas for Divans and RAM
serverSideFilter.conclusion: Avito offers no reservation filter, so removing reserved listings can only be a declared local predicate over the page it returned

defaultBranch.churn: two IDs differed between the two requests in both directions; both belong to the non-reserved set

liveVerification.regression: strict verify of avito/search, avito/page and avito/filter all passed over full 50-row pages; columns and fixtures unchanged
liveVerification.note: one earlier refined call failed with a typed TIMEOUT from the items API after 20 s and was repeated once after a pause, without weakening validation

pageCommand.churn: one ID differed between the two requests

filterCommand.churn: none; the filtered set is a strict subset of the control set
